description: PEMS2023-SANJOSE: A Curated Multi-Sensor Traffic Flow Dataset for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Nidhi Meshram. "This dataset provides a cleaned and research-ready traffic flow time series derived from raw records downloaded from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS). The raw PeMS files were processed to retain a compact and consistent representation of traffic activity across 319 monitoring stations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
